issues.description: Cluster labels in Fig.1H are partially garbled in the markdown extraction; cluster count estimated as 8 (AT2-like, CXCL+ AT2-like, Cycling AT2-like, Ciliated-like, Differentiating basal-like, Differentiating pulmonary NE, Intermediate, NE progenitor) plus doublets. Some labels may be imprecise.
HTII-280 (candidates 5 and 13) is an antibody/antigen rather than a gene entity; no unique gene symbol could be assigned, so it was excluded from gene-level markers.
Candidate 11 original symbol 'NASPA' is a typo for NAPSA; normalized to NAPSA.
SOX2 is shown in Fig.EV2G UMAP feature plot but is not explicitly assigned to a specific cell type in the text; therefore not included as a new finding.

SOX9 (candidate 19) and SFTPC (candidate 28) were judged context_only for AT2-like/AT1 respectively because the author presents them as markers of other populations (fetal tip progenitor and AT2, respectively), with negative expression used for validation rather than annotation.
